bindings.variant: measure (non-debuggable testOnly, applicationId org.libreboard.keyboard.debug, CTC-first fusion APK)

findings: Full swipe shard 1/3 completed: 17,945 rows (corpus remainder 53,836 = 17,946 + 17,945 + 17,945). Driver exit 0, instrumentation OK (1 passed, 3 skipped), wall 24,869.8 s (~6.91 h).
CTC is AVAILABLE on every row: top-1/top-3 84.16%/90.97%, p50/p95 94.3/131.0 ms, max 900.5 ms, 8 empty slates, 82 rows over 200 ms. Still short of the 90%/95% absolute gates.

Production fused_swipe is 68.48%/74.28% with p50/p95 213.8/229.6 ms. That is up from the pre-fusion 500-row diagnostic (46.6%/50.4%) and still well behind CTC. 11,019/17,945 rows (61.4%) exceed the 200 ms budget; 8,927 sit in 210–220 ms. 111 fused slates are empty; 96 of those had the target at CTC rank 1.

fused_relaxed (standalone CTC+geometric into the same fusion boundary, no proposal deadline) is 86.43%/91.94% and beats CTC, so the ranking rule works when both decoders are allowed to finish. The production path is the remaining deficit: fused top-1 equals CTC top-1 on only 71.0% of rows, and CTC hits top-1 while fused misses on 3,251 rows.

Strata: short fused top-3 96.66% clears 90%; return_trip fused top-3 56.72% does not. long fused top-1 46.11% vs CTC 73.93%. Geometric relative-error-reduction vs fused is +41.9% (clears the 20% geometric-RER gate while the absolute swipe gates fail).

The 20-row fusion smoke (75%/80%, matching CTC) was a different unsharded sample and does not hold on the full shard. Quality is stable across quintiles (fused top-1 67.6–70.4%), so this is not a mid-run circuit-breaker collapse.
Geometric still times out on 5,384/17,945 rows (30.0%) at the 1,500 ms standalone deadline. Lexicon cold-start 9.4 s. peakAddedNeuralMemoryMiB 385.2.
limitations: Diagnostic only. The measure APK is the CTC-first fusion build (SHA-256 5b91a54f…), not the pinned debugNoMinify APK 8b8eb864… used by stock-hw-shard0-1 and grapheneos-hw-shard1-1, so these rows cannot enter the Phase 0 matrix as-is.
Shard 1/3 only. Stock swipe evidence remains the 17,946-row shard 0/3 under the pre-fusion ranking.
Compiling the androidTest package to speed caused an ART class-loader-context abort on this device; the test APK was left at verify. The app package is speed.
releaseEligible is false. Pooled matrix evaluation still needs the low-RAM environment.
scope: Diagnostic GrapheneOS swipe shard 1/3 with the CTC-first fusion measure APK AOT-compiled at speed. Tests whether the 20-row fusion smoke holds on a full shard. Not a Phase 0 matrix replacement.
